_doc: Guest allies of the story quests (I-199, docs/notes/battaglia.md#alleati-20xx). In the JP 4.3.1 stage files these families appear ONLY as the single member of a team with flag 0x20 (51 teams, 46 stages; tmp/npc20xx/scan.py), and the client keeps such actors in its ally list (1.0.1 setupEnemyActorPlatoon, 4.3.1: never tappable, never attacked, they attack the enemies after the player's turn. Used by recon/tools/make_jp_enemies.py (ally completeness rule: wait + atk1_o; move/knockback/dead copied from wait when absent) and server/make-enemy-oltre.js (name, original template row 2001-2003, graphic = family if served, else `look`). template = enemyId of the original row whose stats and moves are copied (thethiny/WW 5.0.1 rows 2001-2003: 210x283, battlePattern 3; 2001 fighter 200100/200101, 2002 healer 200200/200201/200202). look = served displayId of a look-alike when the family's own graphics are incomplete (substitute, Notice «Story Quests 526-979»): 2001 Hercules for the non-keyblade characters, 2002/2003 keyblade wielders for the keyblade wielders.
